# npm run regen: regenerates every generated file and automatic document, in dependency order. Run it before every commit (the CI `check` steps fail when a generated document is out of date).
# Stops at the first failure. `check-stability --write` only ever shrinks the known list: it refuses (and regen stops) when a violation is new or worse, which needs a human decision.
